appearance_facts.fact: A blue solid line with circular markers represents Hydroelectricity; the 2010 point is a blue circle near the lower-middle vertical range.
A red dashed line with square markers represents Nuclear energy; the 2010 point is a red square slightly above the 2010 Hydroelectricity point.
A blue text annotation '35%' is positioned just above the 2010 Hydroelectricity marker.
A red text annotation '23%' is positioned just below the 2015 Nuclear energy marker.
A blue text annotation '47%' is positioned above a later Hydroelectricity marker (around 2035).
A red text annotation '28%' is positioned below a later Nuclear energy marker (around 2035).
Both the blue Hydroelectricity line and the red Nuclear energy line converge at the top-right endpoint near 2050.
The red Nuclear energy line peaks around 2005, then drops sharply to its lowest point around 2015.

printed_facts.fact: Point annotation '35%' is associated with the Hydroelectricity series at the 2010 date.
Point annotation '23%' is associated with the Nuclear energy series at the 2015 date.
Point annotation '47%' is associated with the Hydroelectricity series at a later date (approx. 2035).
Point annotation '28%' is associated with the Nuclear energy series at a later date (approx. 2035).

public_definitions: Route the source record that should receive priority follow-up for the higher generation-share case.
Base the routing decision on the dashboard view comparing Hydroelectricity and Nuclear energy for 2010, and select the source record to advance into the higher-share follow-up workflow.
uncertain: The exact percentage value for Nuclear energy in 2010 is not explicitly annotated; its value must be inferred from its vertical position relative to the 2010 Hydroelectricity point and the 2015 '23%' annotation.
